summary.oneLiner: Pritika Auto delivered record FY26 volumes (52.6k MT) and revenue (INR 483cr, +35% YoY) but faced transient Q4 margin compression (12% vs ~16% historical) due to raw material spikes; guidance points to 15% CAGR, margin recovery to 15-16%, and aggressive capacity expansion via cost-efficient LFC technology to hit 100k MT target.

one-line thesis: Pritika Auto delivered record FY26 volumes (52.6k MT) and revenue (INR 483cr, +35% YoY) but faced transient Q4 margin compression (12% vs ~16% historical) due to raw material spikes; guidance points to 15% CAGR, margin recovery to 15-16%, and aggressive capacity expansion via cost-efficient LFC technology to hit 100k MT target.
financial scorecard: Revenue: INR 138.5cr (Q4, +36% YoY), INR 483cr (FY26, +35% YoY); EBITDA: INR 16.6cr (Q4, 12.0% margin), INR 71cr (FY26, 14.7% margin); PAT: INR 4.8cr (Q4), INR 23.2cr (FY26); Order Book: >INR 600cr (Overbooked); Net Debt: ~INR 180cr (D/E <1); One-offs: Q4 margin hit due to sudden RM/gas price spike (4-6% cost increase) with 1-quarter lag in pass-through.
guidance: Revenue Growth: ~15% CAGR for next 2-3 years (Target INR 600cr); Margin: Recovery to 15-16% EBITDA from Q1FY27 onwards; Order Inflow: Strong, fully booked; Capex: INR 25-30cr (FY27, debt-funded) for 7.8k MT; INR 60-70cr (FY28, debt+equity) for 20-24k MT LFC.
order book & pipeline: Fully booked/Overbooked; Estimated value >INR 600cr; LFC segment constitutes ~20% of current order book.
segment / subsidiary detail: Tractor segment (largest, ~60-70% of top customers) driving growth; CV segment volatile but supported by infra spend; Railway segment in qualification phase, revenue expected from FY27; Product mix shifting from small/medium to large castings (higher value/margin).
growth verticals / optionality: 1) Capacity ramp to 100k MT via LFC (50% lower capex/ton vs conventional); 2) US entity (Omnia Eng) for direct exports targeting 18-20% margins vs 14-15% domestic; 3) New geographies (South Korea shipments started, Europe exploring); 4) Railway diversification.
margins & cost dynamics: Q4 margin dip (12%) attributed to 4-6% raw material/freight/gas cost spike with 1-quarter pass-through lag; Legacy products (60% mix) have lower margins vs new components (40% mix); LFC offers 1-2% premium over conventional; Management expects return to 15-16% as costs stabilize and pass-through completes.
capex / expansion: FY27: INR 25-30cr (7.8k MT Green Sand + machining, debt-funded); FY28: INR 60-70cr (20-24k MT LFC, debt+equity); LFC capex intensity ~INR 25k/ton vs ~INR 40-50k/ton for conventional greenfield.
capital allocation: Disciplined approach: Debt-funded near-term expansion (keeping D/E <1); Equity raise considered for FY28 large LFC expansion; US subsidiary initial tranche $50k (total plan $100k) for market foothold; No dividend mentioned, focus on reinvestment.
risks & watch-items: Raw material volatility (steel, energy) and pass-through timing delays; Geopolitical disruptions impacting crude/chemical costs; Tractor demand cyclicality (monsoon dependence); Execution risk on large LFC capex; Litigation history on land acquisition (withdrawn from Hoshiarpur auction).
management quality / tone: Confident on volume growth and technology shift (LFC); Transparent on Q4 margin headwinds (temporary); Aggressive on capacity targets (100k MT); Cautious on EV disruption (low near-term impact on tractor/CV); Pragmatic on funding (debt first, then equity).
non-obvious takeaways: LFC technology allows modular capacity addition (500-1.5k MT blocks) at half the capex of conventional lines, enabling faster ROI; US entity strategy targets arbitrage of 300-500 bps higher EBITDA margins by bypassing Indian intermediaries; 60/40 legacy/new product mix creates a natural margin ramp as legacy items phase out.

themes.title: Auto components & EV-driveline localization
themes.need: Premiumization, content-per-vehicle rise and EV/hybrid transition pull a deep auto-ancillary chain - MOTHERSON/SONACOMS/BOSCHLTD/SCHAEFFLER/SKFINDIA/UNOMINDA-tier on driveline, bearings, wiring (MSUMI) and EV systems; OLAELEC/ATHERENERG/OLECTRA on EV OEMs (OLAELEC targeting cell-to-pack 10-15% cost edge); SUNDRMFAST/ENDURANCE/CRAFTSMAN/BHARATFORG on forgings/machining. Q1FY27 showed contracted pricing finally landing for Tier-2s: SSWL earned EBITDA/wheel of Rs 314 against Rs 262 YoY, which management attributed mostly to two years of OEM input-price increases finally landing (1-5%, more pending) rather than mix, with all plants above 95% utilisation and knuckles at 100%; KROSS delivered a 12.23% EBITDA margin (+63bps) BEFORE two retrospective pass-throughs land (steel settled ~15 July, the CV conversion-cost settlement still pending), making Q1 a floor rather than a peak.
themes.driver: GST 2.0 demand pull; retrospective OEM price pass-throughs still to land (KROSS CV conversion cost); EV cell/Gigafactory ramps (OLAELEC 6GWh by June); export + new-platform content wins.

themes.title: Auto OEM cycle - CV replacement & PV premiumization
themes.need: GST 2.0 rate rationalization plus an aged CV fleet still frames the replacement cycle, but Q1FY27's real signal is 2W OEMs EXPANDING margin through a commodity shock. TVSMOTOR sold 1.63mn units (+28%) on INR 13,896cr revenue (+38%) while lifting EBITDA margin 30bps to 12.8% having absorbed a ~4% commodity shock with only ~1.5% of price increase (CARE upgraded it AA+ to AAA), and committed 2W capacity from 6.8mn to 8.3mn by Q4FY27. BAJAJ-AUTO set volume/revenue/EBITDA records with margin at 20.9% (+110bps) through ~4.5% commodity inflation AND ~10% of volume lost to a ransomware shutdown, with EV now 30% of domestic revenue at double-digit EBITDA and Chetak EBITDA-positive - a scaled, profitable EV second engine. Commercial mobility is electrifying fastest: TVSMOTOR's 3W EV penetration crossed 40% for the first time. ASHOKLEY's all-time-high CV volumes (220k units, MHCV share 30.8%) carry the CV leg with defence + Switch EV optionality; TMCV/TMPV/SMLMAH/ESCORTS on CV/tractors; APOLLOTYRE/JKTYRE/BALKRISIND/MRF on tyres.
themes.driver: Capacity commissioning against demand (TVSMOTOR 2W to 8.3mn by Q4FY27, BAJAJ-AUTO 7m to 9m+ units); 3W/2W EV penetration inflection; GST-2.0 price-cut demand, aged-fleet replacement and festive 2W/PV.
